searchText: MSRP $235,264. New 2026 Grand Design Lineage Series M 25TK Features Series M Package Natural Teak Wood Grain Lineage Suspension Package Starlink Internet SafeRide RV Road Ultra Fabric Soft Touch Interior Package Full Body Paint - Midnight Wave Lineage Blackout Package Power Theater Seats More About This RV Perfect for couples or families who love to travel in style, this motorhome has everything you wish for in a coach. The rear twin beds convert to a king-sized bed, providing a spacious and comfortable sleeping area for two. The full bathroom is equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, providing a convenient spot to freshen up after a long day of exploring. The kitchen is equipped with a 10 cu refrigerator for ample storage, a microwave, and a two-burner cooktop for trying out any trending recipe. In addition, the pantry provides more storage for food and cookware.The 32' smart TVs in the bedroom and living room provide endless entertainment options, while the power seating ensures comfortable viewing angles. The bunk over the cab provides additional sleeping space for kids or adults, and the exterior TV offers an ideal spot to enjoy your favorite shows or sports teams while outdoors. Grand Design's first motorized coach, the Lineage Series M is coming to you with luxurious features at a great value. This Class C diesel motorhome sits on a Mercedes-Benz sprinter chassis for quality and performance you can trust. True to Grand Design's foundation, the Lineage includes interior comforts, durable construction, innovative features, and attention to detail. The Series M Package includes natural teak wood grain, a Lineage Suspension Package, and more. There is also a Blackout Package with black aluminum wheels, a Chromeout Package with chrome aluminum wheels, plus additional packages to enhance your travel experience!
